A Small Collection Of Names

Every name I have
for you.

Eight pictures, eight things I've called you — strung together, the way they've always lived in my head.

Scroll
01 — First

The Rose

Before I knew what to call you, this is the word that came closest.

02

The Prettiest Lady

Not a compliment I hand out easily. With you it was never a choice.

03

A Piece of the Moon

Something that only shows its full self to whoever bothers to look up.

04

My Life Line

The thread that keeps everything else from unraveling.

05

My Heart

Simple. Overused by everyone else. True, when I say it about you.

06

First & Last Love

Everything in between was just waiting for you.

07

Daku Manjal Sing

The name only I use — the one that makes you laugh instead of blush.

08 — Last, but never least

Cutto

The silly one. The one that means I'm not being serious — except I am.

Eight names. One person. All of them still true.
